title: crossstack snap coverage estimate scratchpad - may 2026
content:
Purpose:
Quick ad-hoc grid to estimate who/where/how much coverage we need for the 'crossstack snap' rollout window. Not an authoritative plan — just a working ledger to align owners, surface friction, and produce a short staffing + econ ballpark for the launch day micro-surge.

Columns: Owner | Surface | Priority (H/M/L) | Est effort (hrs) | Backup | Friction notes | Quick econ ($)
Rows:
- Marco Li | Routing fallback lanes (us-west -> eu fallback) | H | 8 | Elena R. | Older config in prod; manual failover steps exist, needs runbook patch | $1,200
- Elena Rodriguez | Model variant fallbacks (q4 -> q3) | H | 6 | Samir K. | Quant mismatch for embeddings; verify embedding shape compatibility | $900
- Samir Khan | Telemetry gating & alerts | M | 4 | Nina P. | Alert thresholds noisy; need to lower sensitivity for rollout | $600
- Priya Shah | Token-cost gating (rate limit tie-ins) | M | 3 | Marco L. | Confirm rate-limit mapping across tiers | $450
- Ops (oncall pool) | Manual surge cover (4-hr shifts) | H | 12 | rotation pool | Need two rotations, one floating SRE | $1,800
- UX (tiny) | Customer-facing status blurb | L | 1 | Product comms | Draft and approve status page snippet | $150

Quick totals (ballpark):
- Sum estimated hours = 34 hrs
- Avg blended rate used = $150/hr -> Ballpark cost = $5,100
- Contingency (30%) = $1,530 -> Total = $6,630

Open questions / decision points:
- Do we require a hard SLA for eu fallback? (affects Marco hours)
- Are we comfortable with q3 quantized model outputs for critical flows? (affects Elena)
- Should we pre-schedule 2x SRE shifts or rely on on-call swap? (affects Ops cost)

Risk & mitigation snippets (quick):
- Risk: Embedding shape mismatch causes silent quality regressions.
  Mitigation: Add quick validation harness (10-minute run) against golden prompt set before enabling fallback. Owner: Elena R.
- Risk: Alert storm during initial switch.
  Mitigation: Pre-mute low-priority alerts, open ephemeral incident channel. Owner: Samir K.

Short-run plan / Next actions (owner -> action -> ETA):
- Marco Li -> Draft runbook patch for manual lane failover; include exact BGP/route change steps -> 2026-05-11 EOD
- Elena Rodriguez -> Run embedding compatibility check across 50 sample requests -> 2026-05-12 AM; if >5% divergence escalate to model team
- Samir Khan -> Create temp alert policy and test in staging -> 2026-05-12 lunchtime
- Priya Shah -> Confirm rate-limit mapping across tiers and publish mapping doc -> 2026-05-12 PM
- Nina Patel -> Consolidate final coverage roster and budget note -> 2026-05-12 EOD

Notes to self / scratch:
- If Elena needs extra cycles, swap 2 hrs from Ops manual surge estimate.
- Confluence quick link to playbook needs a 1-line summary for execs (add to the status blurb).
- Slack ping: @oncall-sre + @product-ops at 09:00 PT on rollout day.

Small transcript of convo that seeded this sheet (copied from slack):
"marco: we might need manual lanes if eu region hits capacity; elena: fallback model is q3 quantized, i'm worried about embedding dims; samir: alerts will scream unless we mute low-prio; nina: quick grid to size effort? i can draft."

This doc is ephemeral — once owners confirm, I'll convert to a formal rota in the week-of-launch tracker and add to the crossfunctional coverage sheet.

Last checked: Nina P. 2026-05-12 14:08 PT
